observations.description: Performance loaded through strict durable checkpoint decoder (ledger_from_bytes). Browser receives sanitized dict only — no executable ledger objects or mutation methods.

Exact values from validated accounting snapshot: cash, equity, realized/unrealized P&L, net result, commissions, exchange fees, slippage, total costs, position, average entry, mark. All as strings (Decimal). No values from order notional.
Missing performance checkpoint: explicitly unavailable with integrity=MISSING and reason=VERIFIED_PAPER_PERFORMANCE_CHECKPOINT_UNAVAILABLE. No fabricated zeros.
Malformed/oversized/symlinked/checksum-invalid/authority-tampered/identity-tampered/unknown-type checkpoints fail closed. Symlinks reject as unsafe. Size validated (0 < size <= 64MB).
Performance and adapter gateway snapshot IDs must match when both checkpoints exist. Mismatched checkpoints reject with 'do not reconcile'. Match accepted.
Checkpoint age uses filesystem mtime only as operational metadata. checkpoint_modified_at and checkpoint_age_seconds present when available.
Equity history chronologically ordered (snapshots are ordered) and capped at 500 entries.
Fill markers use exact fill_id, order_id, time, side, quantity, and economic_price from accounting events.
Dashboard remains localhost-only, read-only, advisory-only, trading_authority=false, live_trading_permitted=false. POST returns 405.
HTML escaping (esc function) and security headers remain effective for all new performance fields.

No credential/provider/broker/exchange/wallet/signing/submission/outbound-network imports. paper_performance_view imports only from execution.paper_performance_checkpoint_v1 (read-only decoder) and backtesting.execution_accounting_v2.accounting.
Legacy missing-performance contract remains compatible when no performance path configured (performance_checkpoint_path=None).
Performance view returns advisory_only=true, live_trading_permitted=false, trading_authority=false. ledger_id and gateway_snapshot_id present as SHA-256.
